scope: complete 1/2/4 protected-counter sets, no aggregation and no global optimum

decisions.candidate: one checked PK per complete set request
decisions.decision: retain existing native caller-owned key capability; no CLI default change
decisions.reason: For 2/4 leaves, avoiding repeated checked loads materially reduces full-set proving request latency. It does not eliminate any proof or local verification. One leaf has no systematic benefit, and peak process RSS is not predictably reduced. No cross-request key cache or new process service is introduced.
The single-state controlled 2x2 study rejected this slower default; the set extension retains automatic Rayon and introduces no additional combination.

Four exact proofs approach the frozen 500m transaction ceiling (about 442m); this is a measured scaling limit, not permission to aggregate. Aggregation needs its own relation, codec, keys/setup, CKB verifier and measured bounds before a dedicated implementation/admission issue.

decisions.candidate: cross-transaction batching or additional proof system
decisions.reason: Live overlapping sets conflict and require complete rebuild/reproof; no joint transaction/ownership/nullifier or alternate verifier trust contract is selected. Existing setup/privacy claims remain unchanged.

retained_default: existing per-invocation CLI key checks and automatic Rayon; native callers may share their checked key within one bounded request
transport_decision: retain unchanged exact leaf proof codec; earlier gzip rejection unchanged
